diff --git a/HISTORY.md b/HISTORY.md
index 847a0cce..198c5a77 100644
--- a/HISTORY.md
+++ b/HISTORY.md
@@ -6,6 +6,10 @@ dev
 
 - \[Short description of non-trivial change.\]
 
+**Bugfixes**
+- ``no_proxy`` now matches hostnames on domain boundaries instead of using
+  simple suffix matching, porting the fix for bpo-39057 from CPython. (#4795)
+
 2.34.0 (2026-05-??)
 -------------------
 
diff --git a/src/requests/utils.py b/src/requests/utils.py
index e69ad0d7..bee589ad 100644
--- a/src/requests/utils.py
+++ b/src/requests/utils.py
@@ -851,7 +851,13 @@ def should_bypass_proxies(url: str, no_proxy: str | None) -> bool:
                 host_with_port += f":{parsed.port}"
 
             for host in no_proxy_hosts:
-                if hostname.endswith(host) or host_with_port.endswith(host):
+                if host_with_port == host or hostname == host:
+                    # The URL does match something in no_proxy, so we don't want
+                    # to apply the proxies on this URL.
+                    return True
+
+                host = "." + host.lstrip(".")
+                if host_with_port.endswith(host) or hostname.endswith(host):
                     # The URL does match something in no_proxy, so we don't want
                     # to apply the proxies on this URL.
                     return True
